cards.intuition: Every symptom has a short list of candidate layers, and each candidate has one cheap check that eliminates or confirms it.
cards.topic: Symptom-to-Layer Triage: Mapping Failures to Pipeline Stages

cards.intuition: For a missing document, walk it: raw landing, silver parse, chunk text, direct index query, filters, rerank order, context budget.
cards.formula: raw -> silver -> chunk -> rank -> filter -> rerank -> context
cards.topic: Symptom-to-Layer Triage: Mapping Failures to Pipeline Stages

cards.intuition: Fixing the wrong layer spends a week on the right layer's neighbor; the refund-policy fix was an afternoon, not a re-embed.
cards.formula: cheap checks first, or pay for the wrong fix
cards.topic: Symptom-to-Layer Triage: Mapping Failures to Pipeline Stages

cards.intuition: Follow a single failing request end to end with its trace ID; one symptom, one variable, watched at every stage boundary.
cards.formula: one trace ID through every stage
cards.topic: Symptom-to-Layer Triage: Mapping Failures to Pipeline Stages

cards.intuition: Optimize only the stage that binds the p95; work anywhere else buys zero user-visible gain.
cards.formula: decompose -> measure p50/p95 -> fix the binding stage
cards.topic: Latency Budget Breakdown: Retrieval, Rerank, Generation

cards.intuition: Retrieval: probes, pruning, sharding, caching. Rerank: depth, batching, hardware. Generation: tokens in, tokens out, model size, routing.
cards.formula: each stage has its own lever set
cards.topic: Latency Budget Breakdown: Retrieval, Rerank, Generation

cards.intuition: Every fix relocates the constraint to wherever you just made room, so decomposition is re-run after every change.
cards.topic: Latency Budget Breakdown: Retrieval, Rerank, Generation

cards.intuition: State the constraints, name the forces, show the chosen point on the frontier, and give each alternative its rejection reason.
cards.topic: Design Review Defense: Justifying Choices Under Constraints

cards.intuition: A real defense ends with what would change your mind: if multilingual crosses 30 percent, re-embed; if retrieval p95 crosses 800 ms, shard.
cards.formula: every decision ships with its reversal condition
cards.topic: Design Review Defense: Justifying Choices Under Constraints

cards.intuition: A decision defended by preference is opinion; defended by constraints, measurements, and reversals, it is engineering.
cards.topic: Design Review Defense: Justifying Choices Under Constraints
